name: Yiff Strip Robotics (EP7)
source:
Yiff Strip Robotics is an adult furry puzzle game, where have to program a robotic arm in order to strip an otter scientist nude!

The seventh of a series of games by Furry Outpost. In this game, Brianne is trying to teach you how to program a robot arm to grab a red cube, and move it from one table to another. Unfortunately for her, Kate has some other plans.

In each round, Kate will send you a code to enter in to the robot arm. Enter it correctly, and the arm will behave how you would prefer it to. Enter it incorrectly, and you'll probably just cause some errors.

If you can get the arm to take off all of Brianne's clothes, you'll receive a fun reward at the end!

[From [url=https://furryoutpost.itch.io/yiff-strip-ep7-robotics]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Yiff Strip Robotics是一款成人毛茸茸的益智游戏，必须对机械臂进行编程才能将水獭科学家脱光！

Furry Outpost系列游戏的第七款。在这款游戏中，Brianne试图教你如何对机器人手臂进行编程，以抓取红色立方体，并将其从一张桌子移到另一张桌子上。不幸的是，凯特还有其他计划。

在每一轮中，凯特都会向你发送一个代码以输入到机器人手臂中。正确输入它，手臂就会按照你希望的方式运行。输入不正确，你可能只会导致一些错误。

如果你能让手臂脱掉布里安娜的所有衣服，最后你将获得有趣的奖励！

[来自[url=https://furryoutpost.itch.io/yiff-strip-ep7-robotics]itch.io[/url]]
